create.sql:
CREATE TABLE `project_membership_requests` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `kind` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `initiator_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `target_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `resolved_at` datetime(3) NULL,
  `resolved_by` bigint unsigned NULL,
  `resolution_code` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_project_status_id` (`project_id`, `status`, `id`),
  KEY `idx_target_status_id` (`target_user_id`, `status`, `id`),
  KEY `idx_initiator_id` (`initiator_id`, `id`),
  KEY `idx_resolved_by` (`resolved_by`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_membership_kind` CHECK (`kind` IN ('invitation','application')),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_membership_status` CHECK (`status` IN ('pending','accepted','rejected','withdrawn','invalidated')),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_membership_applicant` CHECK (IF(`kind` = 'application', `initiator_id` = `target_user_id`, 1) = 1),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_membership_resolution` CHECK (IF(`status` = 'pending', `resolved_at` IS NULL AND `resolved_by` IS NULL AND `resolution_code` IS NULL, `resolved_at` IS NOT NULL AND `resolution_code` IS NOT NULL) = 1),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_project_membership_requests_project_id` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_project_membership_requests_initiator_id` FOREIGN KEY (`initiator_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_project_membership_requests_target_user_id` FOREIGN KEY (`target_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_project_membership_requests_resolved_by` FOREIGN KEY (`resolved_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
